class.name: IfcPreDefinedColour
class.brief_description: The pre defined colour determines those qualified names which can be used to identify a colour that is in scope of the current data exchange specification (in contrary to colour specification which defines the colour directly by its colour components). NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 name: pre_defined_colour. It has been made into an abstract entity in IFC. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-46:1994, p. 14
